node.title: Re^2: Converting Hashes to Objects
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thanks :-)

I often miss Java's standard object methods toString, equals, compareTo, perhaps serialise.

The first three would usually be done with [doc://overload]ing, I guess, and serialization depends on the format (like [doc://Storable] or one of the many text-based formats). I wrote a bit about the complexity of equals and hashCode [id://1194238|in this node].

Another thought is to provide a *safe and proper* way to convert from a string representation of a perl data structure(pds) to pds

I tried to do something like that with [mod://Config::Perl] (see [id://1167085]).
